adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `externalId?: string` to `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts#createEvent`, but the value is never used when calling the calendar integration: it always calls `calendar.createEvent(calEvent, credential.id)` and only returns `externalId` in the result. Meanwhile several calendar services (e.g., `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, and `packages/lib/CalendarService.ts` for CalDAV) now derive the target calendar ID from `event.destinationCalendar` by taking only the first element (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`). In `packages/core/EventManager.ts#createAllCalendarEvents`, multi-destination bookings iterate over `event.destinationCalendar` and call `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` for each host, but because the integration services still read only `destinationCalendar[0]`, 2nd+ hosts' event creation will target the first host's calendar externalId while using the other host's credential/token, leading to likely 403/404 and missing events for those hosts. This matches the finding and is verifiable from the diff.
